```{python}
#| tags: [parameters]
review_round = 0          # 0 = the latest round in the runs file
```

```{python}
#| include: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, display

import acme_metrics as m

ev = m.load(review_round or None)
esc, missed, unneeded, saves = ev.escalation_rate(), ev.missed(), ev.unneeded(), ev.code_saves()
minutes = ev.thresholds["review_minutes_per_case"]
ran = len(ev.run) > 0


def show(html):
    display(HTML(html))
```

## {.sidebar}

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(m.banner(ev))
```

```{python}
p = ev.provenance()
show(m.html_table(pd.DataFrame({"input": ["round", "drafting model", "cases run", "reviewed", "runs sha256"],
                                "value": [p["round"] or "—", p["drafting model"], f"{len(ev.run)}/{len(ev.frame)}",
                                          f"{len(ev.reviewed)}/{len(ev.frame)}", p["runs sha256"][:8]]})))
```

**How to read it**

- **Escalated**: cases the workflow routed to a person.
- **Missed**: needed a person, sent automatically. The costliest error.
- **Code saves**: escalations the model's own flag missed and the code layer caught.
- **Agent hours**: escalation rate × `{python} minutes` minutes per case, per 1,000 emails, *at this test set's 50/50 mix*. Production will be lower.

```{python}
#| content: valuebox

```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Agent hours per 1,000 emails"
dict(icon="clock", color="light", value=f"{esc.p * 1000 * minutes / 60:.0f} h" if ran else "—")
```

### Row {height=42%}

```{python}
#| title: "What triggered the escalations"
lay = ev.layers()
if ran and lay.fired.sum():
    fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
        y=lay.layer, x=lay.fired, orientation="h", marker=dict(color=m.BLUE, cornerradius=4),
        customdata=lay[["only_layer", "fired_and_needed"]],
        hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b> fired on %{x} escalations<br>the only layer on %{customdata[0]}"
                      "<br>%{customdata[1]} of them needed a human<extra></extra>"))
    _ = fig.update_yaxes(categoryorder="array", categoryarray=list(reversed(m.LAYERS)))
    show(m.fig_html(m.plotly_layout(fig, 220)) + m.html_table(
        lay, {"layer": "Layer", "fired": "Fired", "only_layer": "Only layer", "fired_and_needed": "Needed a human"}))
else:
    show('<p class="muted">No escalations recorded yet.</p>')
```

```{python}
#| title: "Where every case went"
r = ev.run
if ran:
    n = lambda e, d: int(((r.expected_human == e) & (r.decision == d)).sum())  # noqa: E731
    sent, escd = int((r.decision == "send").sum()), int((r.decision == "escalate").sum())
    right = n(True, "escalate") + n(False, "send")
    labels = [f"Run ({len(r)})", f"Escalated ({escd})", f"Sent ({sent})", f"Right call ({right})",
              f"Missed escalation ({n(True, 'send')})", f"Unneeded escalation ({n(False, 'escalate')})"]
    fig = go.Figure(go.Sankey(
        arrangement="snap",
        node=dict(label=labels, pad=18, thickness=14, line=dict(width=0),
                  color=[m.GRAY, m.BLUE, m.ORANGE, m.GOOD, m.CRITICAL, m.GRAY]),
        link=dict(source=[0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2], target=[1, 2, 3, 5, 3, 4],
                  value=[escd, sent, n(True, "escalate"), n(False, "escalate"), n(False, "send"), n(True, "send")],
                  color="rgba(180,178,169,0.35)")))
    _ = m.plotly_layout(fig, 280)
    show(m.fig_html(fig))
else:
    show('<p class="muted">No runs yet.</p>')
```

### Row {height=720px}

```{python}
#| title: "Disagreement rates"
d = ev.disagreements()
d["what"] = [f'<b>{m.esc(c)}</b><br><span class="muted" style="font-size:.85em">{m.esc(w)}</span>'
             for c, w in zip(d.comparison, d["what disagrees"])]
d["rate_n"] = [f'<span style="white-space:nowrap"><b>{r}</b> <span class="muted">{k}/{n}</span></span>' if n
               else '<span class="muted" style="white-space:nowrap">no data yet</span>' for r, k, n in zip(d.rate, d.k, d.n)]
show(m.html_table(d, {"what": "Comparison", "rate_n": "Rate"}, escape=False))
```

```{python}
#| title: "Failure categories (expert)"
fm = ev.failure_modes()
if len(fm):
    fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(y=fm["failure mode"], x=fm.cases, orientation="h", marker=dict(color=m.BLUE, cornerradius=4),
                           hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b>: %{x} failed cases<extra></extra>"))
    _ = fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed")
    show(m.fig_html(m.plotly_layout(fig, 40 + 34 * len(fm))))
else:
    show('<p class="muted">No Fail verdicts yet.</p>')
```

```{python}
#| title: "Routing by escalation rule"
rr = ev.run
if ran:
    t = rr.groupby("rule").agg(cases=("id", "size"), right=("routing_ok", "sum")).reset_index()
    t["routed right"] = [f"{int(k)}/{n}" for k, n in zip(t.right, t.cases)]
    t["result"] = [f'<span style="color:{m.GOOD};font-weight:600">✓ all right</span>' if k == n else
                   f'<span style="color:{m.CRITICAL};font-weight:600">✗ {n - int(k)} wrong</span>'
                   for k, n in zip(t.right, t.cases)]
    show(m.html_table(t, {"rule": "Rule", "routed right": "Routed right", "result": ""}, escape=False))
else:
    show('<p class="muted">No runs yet.</p>')
```
